mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPI YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous month AND UNRATE < previous month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) increase of more than 25 basis points signals tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST MoM < -5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) combined with a decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a mismatch between economic growth and supply capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > previous quarter AND INDPRO < previous month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 increases and INDPRO decreases.
